mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 67 degrees out by the Military Ridge State Trail. We also have a Full Moon tonight, and the International Space Station will make an appearance starting at 4:11 AM for 3 minutes. Look for it rising in the west-northwest near Cross Plains before it travels toward the northeast near the Home Depot, staying low near the horizon.

The City of Verona has begun the eighteen-month process of updating the 2026 Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-term guide for future growth, land use, and transportation. A dedicated Task Force has been formed, and the city is encouraging public participation to help shape the vision for the community through the Envision Verona website. In other updates, residents can register for a fun lunch outing to Culver's on September 17.

There is plenty to do in Verona today. You can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, check out the yoga session at Insight Wellness, shop at the downtown Farmer's Market, grab a pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company, or test your knowledge at The Bogey Factory's trivia night. Looking ahead, don't miss the Hop Haus trivia tomorrow.
In a noteworthy call for service on August 21, officers stopped a vehicle for expired registration and discovered marijuana inside, which resulted in the driver receiving a citation for possession.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
